description: Returns the canonical public URL for a Neblla app in the gallery. ALWAYS call this after neblla_create_app — never construct the URL yourself. Two links: `pre` is the private link where the developer tries what is being worked on (give it to the developer only), and `url` is what the users open, at play.neblla.com/<slug or id> (or the app's own domain); it serves the app once neblla_promote has sent pre to pro (`promoted` says whether that has happened). The slug can be renamed with neblla_set_slug. This is the Neblla-hosted address; an app the developer hosts on their own domain keeps its own URL.
name: neblla_get_app_url
